interventions.what: text screen, BIOS data area and GOAL.EXE memory (the match clock DS:831F/831D/8325/831B, the seed DS:7B62, the score DS:9B3C/9B3D, the commentary ring, the squad words and every squad player's +0x12 rating word, the man-of-the-match word DS:7C3A) read from DOSBox-X savestates (Host+S; components Vga and Memory)
savestates written at every read; one loaded (Host+L): the start state; the match runs watched from the captain screen

start_state.restore: fresh DOSBox-X process (config sha256 083897d321ed9fe50ca93bbf03ff45765c03c0f2a6e5e5df57aede499ebdc147), game folder recreated from the verified release copy, GOAL run to its title screen; key n to change the screen; then Host+L loads E006's published main-screen savestate whose sha256 is given (e006-2100-r0005.sav, release E006; the start state of E010's runs from the same E006 run); polled until the screen digest equals the one stored with it (18190236ee20f9eb0573e82714034e41226a92a62efb4c119d8648e06a9a1b67); DOS clock of this session not set

observations.field: host UTC time at launch
host local time at launch, with UTC offset, and zone name
DOSBox-X config of the session, host paths replaced by <work> and <game>
observations.value:
[sdl]
fullscreen=false
output=surface
mapperfile=<work>/mapper.map
[mixer]
nosound=true
[midi]
mididevice=none
[dosbox]
machine=svga_s3
memsize=16
saveremark=false
captures=<work>/cap
[cpu]
core=auto
cputype=auto
cycles=30000
[autoexec]
mount c <game>
c:
mount d <work>/dosclock
date /t > d:\clock.txt
time /t >> d:\clock.txt
c:
goal
exit
